recipes.title: Brewed Spearmint, Date & Orange Rolled Oats
recipes.summary: Fragrant warm rolled oats simmered in freshly steeped dried spearmint herbal tea and milk, topped with sweet diced dates and orange zest.

ingredient_details.note: 1.5 tsp dried spearmint steeped 5 minutes and strained

steps: Steep dried spearmint leaves in 3/4 cup hot water covered 5 minutes, then strain.
Simmer rolled oats, brewed spearmint tea, milk, and chopped dates 6 to 7 minutes until creamy and tender.
Spoon into a warm bowl and finish with orange zest and chopped walnuts.
tips: Spearmint is gentler and sweeter than peppermint, pairing wonderfully with warm grains and fruit.
Naturally caffeine-free and soothing for digestion.

recipes.title: Greek Yogurt, Berry, Honey & Dried Spearmint Bowl
recipes.summary: Cool plain Greek yogurt topped with sweet strawberries, blueberries, toasted oats, honey, and a delicate crumble of dried or fresh spearmint.

ingredient_details.item: crumbled dried spearmint (or 1 tbsp fresh snipped)

steps: Spoon plain Greek yogurt into a chilled bowl and layer with sliced strawberries and blueberries.
Rub dried spearmint gently between your fingers to wake its sweet aroma and sprinkle over the fruit.
Top with toasted rolled oats and a light drizzle of honey.
tips: Rubbing dried spearmint between your fingertips releases fresh essential oils right before eating.
High in morning protein and takes under 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Gentle Turkish Cilbir-Style Yogurt, Poached Eggs & Spearmint
recipes.summary: Traditional Turkish breakfast layering room-temperature garlicky Greek yogurt, soft poached eggs, warm olive oil, sweet paprika, and dried spearmint.
steps: Stir room-temperature Greek yogurt with grated garlic and a pinch of salt and swoosh across a shallow bowl.
Warm olive oil gently off-heat with sweet paprika and crumbled dried spearmint for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Nestle warm poached eggs over the creamy yogurt and drizzle the ruby-green spearmint oil across the top.
tips: Warming dried spearmint in gentle olive oil is a classic Turkish technique that turns it vibrant and deeply aromatic.
Ultra-soft, protein-rich, and delicious scooped with warm whole-grain bread.

recipes.title: Smashed Sweet Pea, Spearmint & Feta Whole-Grain Toast
recipes.summary: Bright spring whole-grain toast spread with tender mashed sweet green peas, lemon juice, olive oil, feta, and sweet spearmint.
steps: Warm frozen peas briefly with 2 tbsp water until bright green and tender, then drain.
Mash warm peas roughly with olive oil, lemon juice, spearmint, and a pinch of salt.
Spread onto warm whole-grain toast and top with crumbled feta cheese.
tips: Sweet peas and spearmint are an iconic spring combination—packed with plant fiber and protein.
Add a soft-boiled egg on top for extra breakfast staying power.

recipes.title: Chilled Spearmint Tea, Cantaloupe & Vanilla Overnight Oats
recipes.summary: Cooling make-ahead oats soaked overnight in brewed spearmint tea, oat milk, chia seeds, and vanilla, served with sweet cantaloupe cubes.

ingredient_details.note: 1.5 tsp dried spearmint steeped 5 minutes, strained and cooled

steps: Steep dried spearmint in 3/4 cup hot water covered 5 minutes, strain, and let cool.
Stir cooled spearmint tea, oat milk, rolled oats, chia seeds, and vanilla in two jars and refrigerate overnight.
Top with sweet chilled cantaloupe cubes right before serving.
tips: Sweet melon and mild spearmint taste crisp and refreshing on warm mornings.
Zero cooking and ready straight from the fridge.

recipes.title: Turkish Ezogelin-Style Red Lentil & Dried Spearmint Soup
recipes.summary: Beloved Anatolian pantry soup simmering red lentils, tomato, onion, and olive oil, finished with classic fragrant dried spearmint and lemon.
steps: Soften diced onion in olive oil 4 minutes, then stir in crushed tomatoes and dried spearmint 1 minute until deeply aromatic.
Add rinsed red lentils and vegetable broth; simmer 15 minutes until red lentils melt creamy and soft.
Blend lightly for velvety texture, brighten with fresh lemon juice, and ladle warm.
tips: Dried spearmint is the authentic heart of Turkish lentil soups—giving gentle warmth and a clean herbal finish.
Naturally dairy-free, high-fiber, and soothing to swallow.

recipes.title: Cool Mediterranean Cacik Cucumber, Chickpea & Spearmint Bowl
recipes.summary: Cooling Turkish yogurt-and-cucumber midday bowl enriched with protein-rich chickpeas, olive oil, lemon, garlic, and fragrant dried spearmint.
steps: Whisk Greek yogurt with 3 tbsp cold water, grated garlic, lemon juice, half the dried spearmint, and a pinch of salt.
Fold in finely diced cucumber and rinsed chickpeas.
Divide into two chilled bowls and finish with extra-virgin olive oil and the remaining dried spearmint.
tips: Wonderfully hydrating, gut-friendly, and cool on warm afternoons.
Scoop with soft pita wedges or eat cleanly with a spoon.

recipes.title: Bright Quinoa, Parsley, Tomato & Spearmint Tabbouleh
recipes.summary: Levantine-inspired gluten-free tabbouleh combining fluffy quinoa, diced cucumber, ripe tomatoes, fresh parsley, lemon, olive oil, and spearmint.
steps: Whisk lemon juice, extra-virgin olive oil, dried spearmint, and a pinch of salt in a salad bowl; rest 3 minutes so the spearmint softens.
Fold in cooked quinoa, chopped parsley, diced tomatoes, and cucumber.
Toss gently and serve cool or room temperature.
tips: Quinoa swaps in effortlessly for bulgur wheat while adding complete plant protein.
Tastes even brighter after chilling 30 minutes in the fridge.

recipes.title: 12-Minute Velvet Sweet Pea & Spearmint Soup
recipes.summary: Vibrant emerald green soup simmering frozen sweet peas, mild onion, vegetable broth, and aromatic spearmint into a silky dairy-free puree.
steps: Soften diced onion in olive oil 3 minutes, then add vegetable broth, frozen sweet peas, and spearmint.
Simmer gently just 5 minutes so the peas keep their vivid emerald green color.
Blend completely velvety smooth with an immersion blender and finish with fresh lemon juice.
tips: Frozen sweet peas are naturally rich in plant protein and fiber and require zero chopping.
Swirl a spoonful of Greek yogurt on top if you enjoy a creamy finish.

recipes.title: Chilled Watermelon, Chickpea, Feta & Spearmint Salad
recipes.summary: Hydrating sweet-savory midday bowl combining juicy watermelon cubes, tender chickpeas, cucumber, feta, lime, olive oil, and spearmint.
steps: Whisk lime juice, extra-virgin olive oil, and spearmint in the bottom of a wide bowl.
Add watermelon cubes, rinsed chickpeas, and diced cucumber and toss lightly.
Scatter crumbled feta across top and enjoy cold.
tips: Adding chickpeas turns a refreshing summer melon salad into a balanced, filling lunch.
Deeply hydrating on hot days.

recipes.title: Moroccan-Style Poached Chicken, Apricot & Spearmint Tagine
recipes.summary: Fragrant North African skillet stew gently simmering chicken thighs with soft dried apricots, chickpeas, cinnamon, lemon, and spearmint over couscous.
steps: Nestle chicken thighs, halved apricots, chickpeas, cinnamon, half the spearmint, and chicken broth in a wide skillet.
Cover and simmer gently 18 minutes until chicken hits 165 F and apricots turn jammy-soft.
Stir in fresh lemon juice and remaining spearmint and spoon over warm fluffy couscous.
tips: Mild sweet spice and spearmint give rich Moroccan character with zero chili heat.
Chicken thighs and simmered apricots stay tender and effortless to cut.

recipes.title: Tender Greek Spearmint & Lemon Turkey Meatballs with Orzo
recipes.summary: Juicy baked lean turkey meatballs scented with Greek dried spearmint, garlic, and lemon zest, served over soft spinach orzo with yogurt sauce.
steps: Heat oven to 400 F; mix ground turkey, quick oats, egg, minced garlic, lemon zest, dried spearmint, and a pinch of salt gently into 12 soft meatballs.
Arrange on a parchment-lined baking sheet and bake 15 to 16 minutes until 165 F and lightly golden.
Serve warm over cooked orzo alongside a spoonful of cool plain Greek yogurt.
tips: Using quick oats instead of breadcrumbs keeps lean turkey meatballs pillow-soft and adds whole-grain fiber.
Freeze extras for 3-minute future dinners.

recipes.title: Baked Lemon Salmon with Spearmint Pea & Potato Mash
recipes.summary: Flaky baked salmon fillets plated over bright green sweet-pea and Yukon Gold potato mash perfumed with sweet spearmint and olive oil.
steps: Boil cubed potatoes 12 minutes, adding frozen peas for the final 2 minutes; meanwhile bake salmon with 1 tsp olive oil and lemon juice at 400 F for 12 minutes.
Drain potatoes and peas, reserving 3 tbsp hot water, and mash smooth with remaining olive oil and spearmint.
Serve flaky baked salmon right over the bright green spearmint mash.
tips: Soft mash and flaky fish require minimal chewing while packing omega-3s and fiber.
Naturally dairy-free and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Baked Spearmint, Chickpea & Tomato Zucchini Boats
recipes.summary: Tender halved zucchini roasted soft and filled with savory rice, chickpeas, diced tomatoes, olive oil, garlic, and fragrant dried spearmint.
steps: Heat oven to 375 F; scoop seeds gently from halved zucchini with a spoon and place cut-side up in a baking dish.
Mix cooked rice, lightly mashed chickpeas, diced tomatoes, garlic, olive oil, and dried spearmint and mound into the zucchini.
Add 3 tbsp water to the dish, cover loosely with foil, and bake 20 to 22 minutes until zucchini is fork-tender.
tips: Inspired by Greek and Lebanese stuffed squash—covering with foil ensures super-soft tender zucchini.
Top with a spoonful of cool plain Greek yogurt before serving.

recipes.title: Warm Turkish Eggplant, Lentil & Dried Spearmint Stew
recipes.summary: Meltingly soft diced eggplant and green lentils braised in tomato, garlic, olive oil, and abundant fragrant dried spearmint.
equipment: Dutch oven or wide skillet with lid
steps: Saute peeled diced eggplant and onion in olive oil 6 minutes until beginning to soften.
Stir in garlic and dried spearmint 45 seconds, then add diced tomatoes, cooked lentils, and 1/2 cup water.
Cover and simmer gently 12 to 14 minutes until eggplant is velvety soft; serve warm over rice or yogurt.
tips: Dried spearmint blooms warmly inside braised Mediterranean tomato stews.
Plant-based, rich in fiber, and wonderfully tender.

recipes.title: Creamy Dark Cocoa, Avocado & Spearmint Tea Smoothie
recipes.summary: Wholesome mint-chocolate shake blending chilled brewed spearmint tea, oat milk, creamy avocado, frozen banana, and cocoa powder.

ingredient_details.note: 1.5 tsp dried spearmint steeped 5 minutes and strained

steps: Steep dried spearmint in 1/2 cup hot water covered 5 minutes, strain, and chill with 3 ice cubes.
Combine chilled spearmint tea, oat milk, frozen banana, avocado, and cocoa powder in a blender.
Blend 50 seconds until velvety smooth and mint-chocolatey.
tips: Sweet spearmint tastes like a cool bakery mint-chocolate cup without artificial extracts.
Naturally dairy-free and sweetened solely by ripe banana.

recipes.title: Chilled Strawberry, Greek Yogurt & Spearmint Smoothie
recipes.summary: Refreshing pink smoothie uniting chilled brewed spearmint tea, Greek yogurt, frozen strawberries, banana, and a drop of honey.

ingredient_details.note: 1.5 tsp dried spearmint steeped 5 minutes and strained

steps: Brew dried spearmint in 3/4 cup hot water 5 minutes, strain, and chill.
Combine chilled spearmint tea, Greek yogurt, frozen strawberries, banana, and honey in a blender.
Blend 45 seconds until thick, frosty pink, and completely silky.
tips: Using chilled brewed spearmint tea guarantees zero dried leaf specks while infusing clean sweet mint flavor.
High-protein and cooling on warm afternoons.

recipes.title: Cool Pineapple, Cucumber & Spearmint Spa Smoothie
recipes.summary: Crisp green refresher blending chilled brewed spearmint tea, frozen pineapple, cucumber, baby spinach, and lime juice.
steps: Blend chilled brewed spearmint tea, baby spinach, and chopped cucumber 20 seconds until smooth.
Add frozen pineapple and lime juice and blend 35 seconds more until frosty emerald green.
Serve immediately.
tips: Tastes like a cool tropical mojito smoothie with zero alcohol and gentle hydration.
Dairy-free, nut-free, and naturally bright.

recipes.title: Blueberry, Sweet Peach & Brewed Spearmint Smoothie
recipes.summary: Vibrant antioxidant blend combining chilled brewed spearmint tea, oat milk, frozen blueberries, frozen peaches, and vanilla.
steps: Pour chilled brewed spearmint tea and oat milk into a blender.
Add frozen blueberries, frozen peaches, and vanilla extract.
Blend 45 seconds until deep berry-violet and smooth.
tips: Keep a chilled pitcher of dried spearmint tea in the fridge to make this 2-minute smoothie effortless.
Naturally sweet without any added sugar.

recipes.title: Frosty Watermelon, Kefir & Spearmint Summer Smoothie
recipes.summary: Light, gut-friendly pink smoothie uniting frozen watermelon cubes, plain kefir, lime juice, and chilled brewed spearmint tea.
steps: Add chilled spearmint tea, plain kefir, frozen watermelon cubes, and lime juice to a blender.
Blend 40 seconds until airy, slushy-smooth, and bright coral.
Pour into a glass and enjoy immediately.
tips: Freeze leftover diced watermelon on a tray for instant cooling smoothies.
Gentle probiotics and soothing spearmint in one refreshing glass.

recipes.title: Iced Moroccan Brewed Spearmint & Citrus Press
recipes.summary: Caffeine-free Moroccan-inspired patio cooler pouring freshly steeped dried spearmint tea over ice with orange juice, lemon juice, and honey.
steps: Steep dried spearmint in 1 1/2 cups hot water covered 5 minutes, strain cleanly, and dissolve honey while warm.
Cool briefly and stir in freshly squeezed orange juice and lemon juice.
Pour generously over tall glasses of ice and enjoy crisp.
tips: Orange and lemon juices turn simple spearmint tea into a vibrant, refreshing afternoon punch.
Naturally caffeine-free so you can sip it any hour.

recipes.title: Chilled Watermelon, Lime & Brewed Spearmint Cooler
recipes.summary: Crystal-smooth strained watermelon juice brightened with chilled brewed spearmint tea and fresh lime juice over ice.
steps: Blend seedless watermelon cubes, chilled strong spearmint tea, and lime juice 20 seconds.
Strain through a fine sieve into two ice-filled glasses.
Serve icy cold right away.
tips: Zero added sweetener—ripe melon and cooling spearmint are pure summer refreshment.
Great way to stay hydrated on warm days.

recipes.title: Sparkling Pineapple, Ginger & Spearmint Tea Tonic
recipes.summary: Crisp bubbly refresher uniting pure pineapple juice, chilled brewed spearmint tea, fresh ginger juice, and plain sparkling water.
steps: Fill a tall glass with ice cubes.
Pour in chilled brewed spearmint tea, pure pineapple juice, and fresh ginger juice.
Top with plain sparkling water, give one gentle stir, and enjoy crisp.
tips: Refreshing mocktail feel with soothing ginger and sweet spearmint.
Swap sparkling water for still chilled water if preferred.

recipes.title: Crisp Cucumber, Green Apple & Spearmint Garden Press
recipes.summary: Clean green juice pairing chilled brewed spearmint tea with fresh cucumber juice, unsweetened apple juice, and bright lemon.
steps: Combine chilled brewed spearmint tea, fresh cucumber juice, apple juice, and lemon juice over ice cubes.
Stir gently until thoroughly chilled.
Sip immediately.
tips: Light, clean, and refreshing without excess natural sugar.
Great midday hydration boost.

recipes.title: Ruby Tart Cherry & Chilled Spearmint Evening Press
recipes.summary: Soothing caffeine-free evening cooler blending unsweetened tart cherry juice, chilled brewed spearmint tea, and a light squeeze of lime.
steps: Pour chilled brewed spearmint tea, tart cherry juice, and lime juice over ice cubes.
Stir gently (adding 1/2 tsp dissolved honey if your cherry juice is very tart).
Enjoy chilled and calming.
tips: Spearmint cools and softens brisk tart cherry juice effortlessly.
100% caffeine-free and rich in ruby antioxidants.

recipes.title: Levantine Spearmint, Tangy Sumac, Grape & Olive Oil Labneh Toast
recipes.summary: Crisp whole-grain toast spread with cool thick labneh, sweet halved grapes, tangy ruby sumac, toasted nigella seeds, cracked black pepper, rubbed spearmint, and extra-virgin olive oil.

ingredient_details.item: crumbled dried spearmint (or 1 tbsp fresh chopped)
thick labneh or strained plain Greek yogurt

steps: Spread thick labneh or strained Greek yogurt generously across warm toasted whole-grain bread.
Press halved sweet grapes lightly into the yogurt layer so they stay neatly in place.
Scatter crumbled spearmint, tangy sumac, nigella seeds, and black pepper on top, then finish with extra-virgin olive oil.
tips: Dried spearmint and ruby sumac are classic Levantine breakfast partners alongside cool yogurt and olive oil.
Ready in 7 minutes with balanced protein, healthy fat, and bright citrusy lift.

recipes.title: Warm Spearmint, Cumin Barley, Celery & Cilantro Soft Egg Bowl
recipes.summary: Savory Mediterranean grain breakfast warming cooked pearl barley and finely diced celery stalk in olive oil with toasted cumin, black pepper, fresh cilantro, sweet spearmint, and a soft egg.
steps: Warm olive oil in a small skillet and sauté finely diced celery stalk with ground cumin and black pepper 3 minutes until crisp-tender.
Stir in cooked pearl barley and 2 tbsp water; warm 4 minutes until steamy and infused.
Fold in fresh spearmint and cilantro off the heat, transfer to a bowl, and crown with a warm soft-cooked egg.
tips: Using leftover cooked pearl barley turns a hearty savory grain bowl into a sub-15-minute weekday breakfast.
Cumin and spearmint lend unmistakable North African warmth.

recipes.title: Sunlit Spearmint, Cantaloupe, Sweet Orange & Flaxseed Oil Morning Bowl
recipes.summary: Hydrating no-cook fruit-and-protein bowl pairing ripe cantaloupe cubes, juicy sweet orange segments, fresh blueberries, cottage cheese, cinnamon, flaxseed oil, and bright spearmint.

ingredient_details.item: fresh spearmint leaves, finely torn (or 1/2 tsp dried)

steps: Spoon cool cottage cheese into a breakfast bowl and swirl in cold-pressed flaxseed oil.
Arrange ripe cantaloupe cubes, sweet orange segments, and fresh blueberries beside the cottage cheese.
Dust lightly with ground cinnamon and scatter torn sweet spearmint leaves over the fruit.
tips: Swirling flaxseed oil into cottage cheese mimics the traditional smooth dairy-flax emulsion.
No cooking required—cool, juicy, and effortless to chew.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Spearmint, Flaked Salmon, Sumac & Cilantro Folded Omelet
recipes.summary: Tender low-heat olive-oil omelet filled with warm flaked cooked salmon, lemony ruby sumac, cracked black pepper, fresh cilantro, and aromatic spearmint.

ingredient_details.item: finely chopped fresh spearmint (or 1/2 tsp dried)

steps: Whisk eggs with 1 tbsp water, half the spearmint, cilantro, and black pepper.
Warm olive oil over medium-low heat, pour in the eggs, and cook gently 2 minutes until softly set underneath.
Scatter flaked salmon, sumac, and remaining spearmint down the center, fold gently in half, and slide onto a warm plate.
tips: Tart ruby sumac gives a clean lemony brightness to salmon without watering down the eggs.
Rich in morning protein and marine omega-3s in 10 minutes flat.

recipes.title: Warm Spearmint Tea, Sweet Cherry, Banana & Dark Chocolate Oats
recipes.summary: Cozy rolled oats simmered in freshly steeped spearmint herbal tea with creamy mashed banana, sweet halved cherries, warm cinnamon, and a silky melt of dark chocolate.

ingredient_details.item: dried spearmint leaves (or 1 spearmint tea bag)
hot water for steeping spearmint tea

steps: Steep spearmint leaves in 1 cup hot water covered 4 minutes, then strain into a small saucepan.
Simmer rolled oats, mashed banana, halved cherries, and cinnamon in the brewed spearmint tea 6 minutes until thick and creamy.
Spoon into a warm bowl and scatter finely chopped dark chocolate over the hot oats so it melts into fragrant mint-cocoa ribbons.
tips: Mashed banana naturally sweetens the oats and adds velvet creaminess with zero dairy needed.
Gentle spearmint, cherry, and dark chocolate feel indulgent while staying whole-grain and soothing.

recipes.title: Levantine Spearmint, Pearl Barley, Sumac & Poached Chicken Bowl
recipes.summary: Hearty Levant-inspired tabbouleh bowl combining tender cooked pearl barley, shredded poached chicken, crisp diced celery stalk, fresh cilantro, generous spearmint, tangy sumac, and olive oil.

ingredient_details.item: fresh spearmint leaves, chopped (or 1.5 tsp dried)
cooked shredded or diced chicken breast

steps: Whisk olive oil, fresh lemon juice, and ground sumac in a large bowl until ruby-tinted.
Fold in cooked pearl barley, shredded chicken, and finely diced celery stalk so every grain absorbs the citrus-sumac dressing.
Toss generously with chopped fresh spearmint and cilantro just before serving.
tips: Pearl barley holds up beautifully in the fridge for 2 to 3 days without getting soggy.
Extra fresh herbs turn a simple grain salad into a fragrant Levantine meal.

recipes.title: Moroccan Spearmint, Cumin-Flaked Salmon, Sweet Orange & Celery Salad
recipes.summary: Inspired by classic Moroccan orange salads, pairing warm cumin-kissed flaked salmon over sweet orange slices, crisp celery stalk, black pepper, extra-virgin olive oil, and torn spearmint.

ingredient_details.note: peeled and thinly sliced into rounds

steps: Warm half the olive oil in a small skillet over low heat, bloom ground cumin and black pepper 30 seconds, and gently warm flaked salmon 2 minutes.
Arrange overlapping sweet orange rounds and thinly sliced celery stalk across a serving platter.
Scatter the warm cumin salmon over the citrus, drizzle with remaining extra-virgin olive oil, and finish with abundant torn spearmint.
tips: Warming cumin briefly in olive oil awakens its toasted fragrance and keeps the salmon silky.
Sweet juicy orange slices pair wonderfully with savory fish and bright mint.

recipes.title: Cooling Spearmint, Cantaloupe, Sweet Grape & Chickpea Walnut Oil Salad
recipes.summary: Crisp no-cook summer lunch tossing tender chickpeas, sweet cantaloupe cubes, halved grapes, finely diced celery stalk, tangy sumac, fresh spearmint, and fragrant walnut oil.
steps: Whisk toasted walnut oil, fresh lemon juice, and ground sumac in a large bowl.
Add drained chickpeas, ripe cantaloupe cubes, halved red grapes, and finely diced celery stalk; toss gently.
Fold in fresh chopped spearmint and serve cool.
tips: Walnut oil adds rich nutty warmth that bridges creamy chickpeas and hydrating summer fruit.
Completely plant-based and requires zero stove time.

recipes.title: Golden Spearmint, Cumin, Turmeric & Celery Chicken Broth Bowl
recipes.summary: Restorative Anatolian-inspired soup simmering shredded chicken and sliced celery stalks in golden olive-oil broth with cumin, turmeric, and black pepper, crowned with dried spearmint.
steps: Warm 1 tbsp olive oil in a saucepan and sweat sliced celery stalks with cumin, turmeric, and black pepper 3 minutes until bright golden.
Pour in chicken broth and shredded chicken; simmer gently 10 minutes until celery is fork-tender.
Ladle into warm bowls and finish with crumbled dried spearmint stirred into the remaining 1.5 tsp olive oil.
tips: Drizzling dried spearmint with warm olive oil over hot soup is a beloved Turkish finishing trick.
Soothing, light, and easy to sip when appetite is modest.

recipes.title: Warm Spearmint, Pearl Barley, Cilantro & Nigella Seed Lentil Plate
recipes.summary: Earthy Middle Eastern plant-based plate combining warm pearl barley and tender green lentils tossed with cumin, toasted nigella seeds, olive oil, fresh cilantro, and aromatic spearmint.

ingredient_details.item: crumbled dried spearmint (or 2 tbsp fresh chopped)

steps: Warm olive oil over medium-low heat and bloom nigella seeds, cumin, and dried spearmint for 45 seconds until deeply fragrant.
Stir in cooked pearl barley, lentils, and 2 tbsp water; warm 5 minutes until glossy and heated through.
Remove from heat, fold in chopped fresh cilantro, and serve warm.
tips: Nigella seeds add a subtle toasted-onion savoriness that complements earthy lentils and cool spearmint.
Top with a spoonful of plain yogurt if desired for extra creaminess.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Spearmint, Sumac, Roasted Grape & Olive Oil Chicken
recipes.summary: Juicy oven-roasted chicken nestled beside sweet bursting red grapes dusted with tangy sumac, warm cumin, olive oil, and black pepper, showered with fresh spearmint leaves.

ingredient_details.item: boneless skinless chicken thighs or breasts

steps: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and toss chicken and red grapes on a parchment-lined pan with olive oil, ruby sumac, cumin, and black pepper.
Roast 18 to 20 minutes until chicken reaches 165°F (74°C) and the grapes burst into tart-sweet juices.
Transfer to warm plates, spoon pan juices over the top, and shower abundantly with torn fresh spearmint.
tips: Roasting red grapes with tangy sumac builds a restaurant-worthy pan glaze with almost zero effort.
Fresh spearmint cools and brightens the savory roasted dish immediately.

recipes.title: Persian-Inspired Spearmint, Saffron Barley & Olive Oil Baked Salmon
recipes.summary: Golden saffron-infused pearl barley tossed with sweet orange zest, fresh cilantro, and bright spearmint, crowned with tender olive-oil baked salmon fillets.

ingredient_details.item: fresh orange zest plus 2 tbsp orange juice

steps: Steep crumbled saffron threads in 2 tbsp hot water 5 minutes until glowing gold; preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Brush salmon fillets with half the olive oil and half the orange juice and bake 12 to 14 minutes until flaky.
Fold saffron liquid, remaining olive oil, orange zest, remaining juice, fresh spearmint, and cilantro into warm pearl barley, then serve topped with baked salmon.
tips: Inspired by Persian sabzi polo (herb rice with fish), using pearl barley for gentle fiber and effortless timing.
Blooming saffron in warm water releases maximum color and floral aroma from just a pinch.

recipes.title: One-Pot Spearmint, Cumin Chicken, Celery & Pearl Barley Pilaf
recipes.summary: Savory one-pot supper simmering pearl barley, tender diced chicken, sliced celery stalk, warm cumin, olive oil, and black pepper in broth, finished with fragrant chopped spearmint.

ingredient_details.item: boneless skinless chicken thighs or breasts

steps: Sauté diced chicken and finely diced celery stalk in olive oil over medium heat 5 minutes until lightly golden; stir in cumin, black pepper, and rinsed pearl barley.
Pour in chicken broth, bring to a gentle simmer, cover tightly, and cook 20 minutes until barley is plump and tender.
Remove from heat, fold in bright chopped spearmint, let rest 3 minutes covered, and fluff before serving.
tips: Resting the covered pilaf for 3 minutes steams the fresh spearmint right through every grain.
Everything cooks together in one pot for simple cleanup.

recipes.title: Skillet Spearmint, Tart Cherry, Sumac & Olive Oil Salmon
recipes.summary: Flaky skillet-cooked salmon topped with a luminous 3-minute Persian-inspired relish of warm halved cherries, ruby sumac, extra-virgin olive oil, black pepper, and fresh spearmint.
steps: Season salmon fillets with half the sumac and black pepper; sear in 1 tbsp olive oil over medium heat 4 minutes per side until flaky, then plate.
Add halved cherries, remaining olive oil, remaining sumac, and 2 tbsp water to the warm skillet; simmer 2 minutes until glossy and juicy.
Fold fresh spearmint ribbons into the warm cherry-sumac relish off the heat and spoon over the salmon.
tips: Tart-sweet cherries with ruby sumac and spearmint create an unforgettable bright sauce in 2 minutes.
Serve alongside steamed couscous, rice, or tender greens.

recipes.title: Cozy Spearmint, Golden Turmeric, Cumin & Celery Chickpea Stew
recipes.summary: Gentle plant-based Mediterranean stew simmering tender chickpeas and sliced celery stalk in olive oil with golden turmeric, cumin, and black pepper, topped with cilantro and warm spearmint oil.

ingredient_details.item: crumbled dried spearmint (plus 1 tbsp fresh if on hand)

steps: Sauté sliced celery stalks in 1 tbsp olive oil with turmeric, cumin, and black pepper 4 minutes until fragrant.
Add chickpeas and vegetable broth, gently mashing a handful of chickpeas with a fork to thicken naturally, and simmer 12 minutes.
Stir fresh cilantro into the stew, ladle into bowls, and top with crumbled dried spearmint warmed in the remaining 1.5 tsp olive oil.
tips: Lightly mashing a few chickpeas creates a creamy, comforting texture with zero heavy cream.
Delicious with warm pita or over soft cooked barley.

recipes.title: Velvet Spearmint, Raspberry, Banana & Dark Chocolate Smoothie
recipes.summary: Cool creamy mint-berry chocolate smoothie blending fresh spearmint leaves, frozen raspberries, ripe banana, finely chopped dark chocolate, flaxseed oil, and oat milk.
steps: Pour unsweetened oat milk into the blender and add fresh spearmint leaves and cold-pressed flaxseed oil.
Add frozen raspberries, ripe banana, and finely chopped dark chocolate.
Blend 50 seconds until silky, rosy-brown, and dotted with crisp cocoa flecks.
tips: Spearmint is milder and sweeter than peppermint, pairing naturally with tart raspberries and dark chocolate.
Use frozen banana slices for an extra-frosty shake texture.

recipes.title: Frosty Spearmint, Sweet Cantaloupe, Orange & Ginger Flax Smoothie
recipes.summary: Cooling coral-orange smoothie blending chilled cantaloupe cubes, freshly squeezed orange juice, mild grated ginger, sweet spearmint leaves, and cold-pressed flaxseed oil.
steps: Combine freshly squeezed orange juice, fresh spearmint leaves, grated ginger, and flaxseed oil in a blender.
Add chilled cantaloupe cubes and ice cubes.
Blend 45 seconds until frosty, bright orange, and velvety smooth.
tips: Ultra-hydrating and completely caffeine-free for warm afternoon energy.
Cold-pressed flaxseed oil adds silkiness without altering the clean melon-mint flavor.

recipes.title: Garden Spearmint, Wild Blueberry, Banana & Ginger Kefir Smoothie
recipes.summary: Refreshing violet probiotic smoothie whirling wild blueberries, ripe banana, fresh spearmint leaves, grated ginger, flaxseed oil, and tangy plain kefir.
steps: Pour plain kefir into the blender along with fresh spearmint leaves, grated ginger, and cold-pressed flaxseed oil.
Add frozen wild blueberries and ripe banana.
Blend 45 seconds until deep purple, smooth, and frothy, then serve immediately.
tips: Kefir pours more lightly than thick yogurt, making an effortless drinkable smoothie.
Fresh ginger and spearmint lend soothing digestive comfort alongside probiotic cultures.

recipes.title: Mocha Spearmint, Sweet Cherry, Chilled Coffee & Dark Chocolate Smoothie
recipes.summary: Cool coffeehouse-style morning blend combining chilled brewed coffee, frozen dark sweet cherries, ripe banana, shaved dark chocolate, milk, and fresh sweet spearmint.
steps: Pour chilled brewed coffee and milk into a blender with fresh spearmint leaves.
Add frozen sweet cherries, ripe banana, and finely chopped dark chocolate.
Blend 50 seconds until frosty, creamy, and lightly speckled with dark chocolate.
tips: Keep leftover morning coffee chilled in a jar in the fridge so this smoothie takes 2 minutes.
Crisp spearmint lifts rich cherry-mocha flavor without any flavored syrups.

recipes.title: Twin-Mint Spearmint, Purple Grape, Raspberry & Lemon Balm Smoothie
recipes.summary: Calming twin-herb berry frost uniting chilled spearmint and lemon balm herbal tea with frozen purple grapes, tangy raspberries, and creamy ripe banana.
steps: Steep spearmint and lemon balm together in hot water covered 4 minutes, strain cleanly, and let cool slightly.
Pour the botanical infusion into a blender with frozen purple grapes, frozen raspberries, and banana.
Blend 50 seconds until icy, smooth, and deeply berry-colored.
tips: Spearmint and lemon balm belong to the soothing mint family and brew into a naturally fragrant base.
Completely plant-based and caffeine-free for any time of day.

recipes.title: Cooling Spearmint, Crisp Celery Stalk, Cantaloupe & Ginger Press
recipes.summary: Crisp spa-style garden press blending sweet cantaloupe, crisp celery stalk, fresh spearmint leaves, mild ginger, and sweet orange juice, strained crystal-smooth over ice.
steps: Blend chopped celery stalks, ripe cantaloupe cubes, fresh orange juice, spearmint leaves, and minced ginger 40 seconds until completely liquefied.
Press through a fine mesh strainer with the back of a spoon into a glass over ice cubes.
Stir lightly and enjoy immediately while brisk and chilled.
tips: Straining yields a clear, silky juice with all the refreshing electrolytes of celery and melon.
Works in any kitchen blender without needing a bulky juicer.

recipes.title: Maghrebi-Style Iced Spearmint, Black Tea, Orange & Lemon Balm Cooler
recipes.summary: North African-inspired chilled iced tea steeping mild black tea with abundant spearmint and calming lemon balm, poured over ice with freshly squeezed sweet orange juice.
steps: Steep the black tea bag with spearmint and lemon balm in hot water covered 3 minutes, then strain cleanly.
Pour the warm herbal black tea directly over a tall glass filled with ice cubes to flash-chill.
Stir in freshly squeezed sweet orange juice and serve cold.
tips: Fresh sweet orange juice replaces heavy refined sugar while echoing North African citrus-mint traditions.
Use decaf black tea for a gentle afternoon glass.

recipes.title: Emerald Spearmint, White Grape, Celery Stalk & Sweet Basil Spritz
recipes.summary: Sparkling emerald botanical press blending crisp celery stalk, sweet basil, and fresh spearmint with chilled white grape juice, strained cleanly and topped with bubbles.
steps: Blend chopped celery stalks, fresh spearmint, sweet basil, and chilled white grape juice 35 seconds until vibrant green.
Strain smoothly through a fine mesh sieve into a tall glass filled with ice cubes.
Top with chilled sparkling water, stir once gently, and serve right away.
tips: White grape juice softens savory celery and unites cool spearmint with sweet garden basil.
Feels like a celebratory zero-proof botanical mocktail.

recipes.title: Ruby Spearmint, Crushed Raspberry, Sweet Orange & Ginger Press
recipes.summary: Jewel-red refresher layering strained crushed raspberries and freshly squeezed orange juice with a lively chilled infusion of spearmint leaves and fresh ginger coins.
steps: Steep spearmint and fresh ginger coins in hot water covered 4 minutes, then strain cleanly.
Crush raspberries lightly with a fork and press through a fine sieve into an ice-filled glass.
Add freshly squeezed orange juice and the strained spearmint-ginger infusion, stir gently, and enjoy chilled.
tips: Warm ginger balances cooling spearmint for a brisk, revitalizing drink.
Naturally vivid and completely free of added sweeteners.

recipes.title: Evening Spearmint, Tart Cherry, Red Grape & Lemon Balm Tonic
recipes.summary: Soothing twilight tonic uniting pure tart cherry juice and sweet red grape juice with a fragrant chilled steep of dried spearmint and calming lemon balm.
steps: Steep spearmint and lemon balm in hot water covered 5 minutes, then strain cleanly.
Combine pure tart cherry juice and pure red grape juice over ice cubes in a glass.
Pour in the strained herbal infusion, stir lightly, and sip slowly.
tips: Sweet red grape juice rounds out brisk tart cherry without needing honey or syrup.
A peaceful caffeine-free evening pour.
